title: Circle Line closures and lessons for North East Line works
asked: What lessons on crowd management, shuttle services and disruption communications were learnt from recent Circle Line closures, and how they will be applied to North East Line closures during its renewal programme.
response: The Acting Minister said LTA kept commuters informed in advance through publicity and community engagement, and deployed crowd marshals at affected stations. Replacement shuttle bus services started two weeks early so commuters could familiarise themselves with alternative routes, which improved the initial period. Wait times and train loading were kept manageable, with most commuters able to board the first train except on certain busy stretches. No decision has been made on scheduled closures for North East Line improvement works, but lessons and commuter feedback will be incorporated into future alternative travel options.

key_points.point: LTA kept commuters informed well in advance through publicity and community engagement efforts.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has kept commuters informed well in advance through publicity and community engagement efforts

key_points.point: Crowd marshals were deployed at affected stations to guide commuters and manage crowds.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: crowd marshals were also deployed to guide commuters and manage the crowds

key_points.point: Replacement shuttle bus services started two weeks early so commuters could familiarise themselves with alternative routes before the service adjustments.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: We also started the replacement shuttle bus services two weeks early to allow commuters to familiarise themselves with alternative routes before the service adjustments

key_points.point: Wait times and train loading were kept manageable.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: we have kept wait times and loading for trains manageable

key_points.point: Most commuters could board the first train, except on certain busy stretches where higher crowding occurs even without planned closures.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: Most commuters continue to be able to board the first train, other than at certain busy stretches where higher crowding is observed even without the planned closures

key_points.point: No decision has been made on whether scheduled closures will be needed for North East Line improvement works.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: We have not decided yet if scheduled closures are going to be needed for the North East Line improvement works

key_points.point: Lessons and commuter feedback will be incorporated into refining alternative travel options for future service adjustments.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: we will incorporate these lessons and feedback from commuters in refining our provision of alternative travel options for future service adjustments

key_points.point: On the supplementary question, the Minister said suggestions for supporting services for North East Line works will be considered when the time comes.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: we will certainly consider those suggestions that he has given us
